title: The Coworker That Remembers
pitch: OpenBot gives a company a roster of self-hosted AI 'coworkers,' each with its own browser, files, and tools — but like most agent platforms, every new conversation starts from zero. Wire claude-mem's session-compression pipeline into OpenBot's gateway so each Bot keeps a running, auditable memory of the company's decisions, tickets, and past conversations instead of relearning them every time. The combination turns a roster of stateless assistants into coworkers that actually get better the longer they work somewhere — sold as a managed-deployment add-on to the operations teams already adopting OpenBot.
why_now: Both trended on the same day: one solves cross-session amnesia for coding agents, the other is a self-hosted internal-AI platform whose biggest early-adopter complaint is exactly that amnesia, just for office work instead of code. The fix is wiring, not a new product.
